# `armadad upgrade`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

upgrade downloads a release, verifies its checksum (and its signature when cosign is
installed), replaces armadad and armada and the systemd units, and restarts
armada-server or armada-agent. Upgrade servers first, one at a time, then the other
nodes (docs/operations.md#upgrades). ARMADA_DOWNLOAD_BASE points at a mirror.

```
armadad upgrade [--version vX.Y.Z] [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--no-restart` | install only; restart the service yourself |
| `--require-signature` | fail unless cosign verifies the release signature (or ARMADA_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=1) |
| `--version string` | release to install (default: the latest) |
